narrative: The almanac open on the board at the twenty-sixth. The margin is blank. The chronicle stays shut. The pen is set down. No second line. No sum.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the mark and closed nothing else.

entities.name: Susanna Shakespeare
entities.context: Named in the margin, not written to yet.

entities.name: the almanac
entities.context: Shown on almanac in Susanna, xij
